title: Step-by-Step: How to Complete Your Profile & Apply for Posts
text:
Step-by-Step: How to Complete Your Profile & Apply for Posts

Follow these steps carefully

Before you begin:
Make sure you have scanned copies (PDF/JPG) of your transcripts, CNIC, experience certificates and your CV/dossier ready.

1. Complete Your Resume / Profile

Fill every relevant section in your profile. Once all sections are completed, click
Move to Dashboard
.

01
Personal Information

02
Academic Qualification

03
Medal / Distinction

04
Experience / Service Record

05
Publications

06
Research Projects

07
Research Thesis

08
Post Doctoral Fellowship

09
Patents

10
Professional / Art Activities

11
Excellence Awards

12
Additional Information

2. Move to Dashboard

After completing all sections, click
Move to Dashboard
. This activates your profile and enables the "Apply for Post" functionality.

3. Apply to a Post

Open
Step 2 – Apply For Post
.

Select the
Advertisement Number
and then the
Post Title
you want to apply for.

Choose the correct
Merit Type
.

Upload your complete
Dossier (CV)
and click
Apply
.

4. Generate Challan and Pay Fee

In the
Applied Posts
table click
Generate Challan
, print it and pay the required fee at the bank.

5. Submit Payment Details & Finalize Application

Open your profile → Step 2 → Applied Posts.

Click the relevant
Post Title
(e.g., Lecturer, Professor).

In the form, scroll to
Payment Details (Sr. #11)
and enter: Challan Number, Amount Paid, Payment Date.

Upload the paid challan/receipt
.

Check the declaration checkbox at
Sr. #12 and click

Submit Application
.

You have successfully applied. Best of luck!

Tip:
If file upload fails, try compressing the file (PDF) to
below 10–15 MB
, clear browser cache, or use Chrome/Edge. If problem persists, contact support.
